mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is in the top 20% of historical levels, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising (defined as 3-month change > 0), or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns due to recessionary pressures on corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20d returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) in the recessionary regime.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 2200 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 2200, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5d returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is below its 200-day moving average, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 60d returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary policy response to inflation that increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are rising (3-month change > 0), or the Rank IC for the interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) is not significantly negative (p>0.05).
